entities.name: Atiin
entities.description: Nomadic human people who travel across planes via the Omenpaths and consider everyone in their homeland family.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes that let the Atiin reach Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane the Atiin have found their way onto.

events.summary: When the first Omenpaths opened, the Atiin simply continued their nomadic journey.
events.quote: When the first Omenpaths opened, the Atiin people simply continued their nomadic journey.
